Q: Which variety is suitable for lowland fields?
A: Varieties suitable for lowland fields include Swarna Sub-1, CR Dhan 801, and MTU 7029.

Q: Which new paddy varieties are available for Kharif season?
A: New paddy varieties available for Kharif season include CR Dhan 315, CR Dhan 317, CR Dhan 318, and CR Dhan 322.

Q: Last year CR 1018 was damaged by wind. Can I plant it again?
A: It is not advisable to replant CR 1018; instead, use lodging-resistant varieties like Kalachampa, CR-1009 SUB 1, or MTU 1223.

Q: What is the name of the variety, its duration, and suitable land type?
A: Pooja is a 145-day variety suitable for medium land.

Q: Which variety is best for lowland fields?
A: CR Dhan 800 and Swarna Sub-1 are best suited for lowland fields.

Q: Is Veena paddy variety good for cultivation?
A: Yes, Veena is suitable for cultivation on upland or medium land and matures in about 120 days.

Q: Which varieties have a 170-day duration?
A: CR-508 and CR-510 are varieties with a 170-day duration.

Q: What are new medium-duration paddy varieties?
A: CR Dhan 317 and CR Dhan 318 are new medium-duration paddy varieties.

Q: Which 150-day varieties give good yield?
A: Pooja, Lalat, and MTU 1001 are 150-day varieties that yield well.

Q: Which variety is good for puffed rice (mudhi)?
A: BINA 1, a bold slender variety, is good for puffed rice and also suitable for Chuda.

Q: Give details about 7061 variety.
A: CR Dhan 7061 (Indrani) is a high-yielding variety with a maturity of around 140 days.

Q: Which varieties are high-yielding?
A: CR Dhan 315, CR Dhan 318, and Swarna Shreya are high-yielding varieties.

Q: Which medium-duration varieties give good yield?
A: Pooja, CR Dhan 310, and Lalat are good yielding medium-duration varieties.

Q: What are the newly released paddy varieties?
A: Newly released paddy varieties include CR Dhan 315, CR Dhan 317, CR Dhan 318, and CR Dhan 322.

Q: How is the yield of Lal Kubera variety?
A: Lal Kubera gives moderate yield and is a specialty red rice preferred by consumers.

Q: What is TL paddy variety?
A: TL refers to �Truthfully Labelled� seeds and not to a specific variety.

Q: Which variety can replace Pooja?
A: Alternatives to Pooja include MTU 1075, Ranjit Sub 1, and Swarna Sub 1.

Q: What new paddy seeds are available now?
A: Currently available new paddy seeds include CR Dhan 318, CR Dhan 322, and Swarna Shreya.

Q: Which variety is best for fallow land?
A: CR Dhan 800 and Swarna Sub-1 are best suited for fallow land.

Q: Which paddy is suitable for medium land this year?
A: CR Dhan 310 and CR Dhan 317 are suitable for medium land, and should be sown from mid-June to early July.

Q: Which varieties are suitable for pest/disease-prone areas?
A: CR Dhan 801 and Swarna Shreya are good choices for pest and disease-prone areas.

Q: Suggest long-duration, waterlogging-tolerant, high-yielding varieties for fallow land.
A: CR 1009 Sub 1, Ranjit Sub 1, and Swarna Sub-1 are suitable for such conditions.

Q: Is 7061 Indrani good for eating?
A: Yes, CR Dhan 7061 (Indrani) has good cooking quality and is preferred by consumers.

Q: Advice on MTU-1140 variety.
A: MTU-1140 is a medium-duration variety (115�120 days) suitable for medium land with good yield.

Q: Are there any good 100-day varieties?
A: Yes, Sahabhagidhan and CR Dhan 207 are good 100-day varieties.

Q: Which variety is best for puffed rice in Kharif?
A: Lalat and Jagabandhu are suitable for puffed rice in the Kharif season.

Q: Tell about DRR 49 variety.
A: DRR 49 is a high-yielding, disease-resistant variety with about 135 days duration.

Q: Which paddy variety gives high yield in fallow land?
A: CR Dhan 800 and Swarna Sub-1 give high yields in fallow land.

Q: Give general advice on paddy varieties.
A: Choose paddy varieties based on land type, season, and duration for best results.

Q: Which varieties are best for Kharif?
A: CR Dhan 315, Swarna Shreya, and Pooja are best for the Kharif season.

Q: Do hybrid rice varieties produce red rice?
A: No, hybrid rice varieties usually produce white grains and not red rice.

Q: Which variety gives better yield than Sarala?
A: Kalachampa, CR-1009 Sub 1, and MTU 1223 give better yield than Sarala.

Q: Can I reuse Kalachampa paddy as seed this year?
A: Yes, Kalachampa paddy can be reused as seed if it has been stored properly and retains good quality.

Q: Is Hasanta smaller or larger than Pratikhya variety?
A: Hasanta is bold with 150 days duration, while Pratikhya is long and slender with 130 days duration.

Q: What is the duration and yield of Pooja variety?
A: Pooja matures in 145 days and yields around 5�6 tons per hectare.

Q: Is 145-day CRRI variety available at Cuttack?
A: Yes, CRRI distributes 145-day varieties like CR Dhan 310 and CR Dhan 318 in Cuttack.

Q: Which other varieties are similar to Kalachampa?
A: Varieties similar to Kalachampa include scented or Basmati-type varieties like Kalajeera and Ketekijoha.

Q: Which variety suits deep fields and short duration?
A: CR Dhan 207 and Sahabhagidhan are suitable for deep fields with short duration.

Q: What is the yield of CR 1018?
A: CR 1018 yields around 5.5�6 tons per hectare but is sensitive to lodging.

Q: Are there any 90-day paddy varieties?
A: Yes, 90-day varieties include Anjali, Vandana, and Khandagiri
